Prices 
Price pressures have strengthened since the last report. Most Districts reported modest to moderate growth in selling 
prices and moderate increases in non-labor input costs. In particular, construction-material costs rose in most regions, 
with many Districts citing increased lumber costs and/or increases in demand for materials due to hurricane rebuild
